headline.purpose: Section headings on landing and app screens.

title.purpose: Brand name, item and card titles.

body.purpose: All running text at 18px, 68ch max, 1.75 line height for Indic scripts.

label.purpose: Buttons, status chips, nav links, selects.

motion.name: rise-once
motion.value: 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0 to 1, translateY 14-18px to 0, once
motion.purpose: Only entrance animation; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: skeleton-step
motion.value: 1.4s ease-in-out infinite, background Deeper Mint to Quiet Line
motion.purpose: Loading placeholder; static under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal fill with ink outline; the one main action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0.55rem 1.4rem; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem; border:2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--color-teal); color:var(--color-ground); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--color-teal-deep); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Plain Button
components.description: Tile Mint secondary action such as Sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0.55rem 1.4rem; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem; border:2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-plain { background:var(--color-tile); color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-plain:active { background:var(--color-ground-deep); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Sticker Tile
components.description: Flat Tile Mint container with a 2px ink outline.
components.css: .ds-tile { background:var(--color-tile); border:2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:4px; padding:1.25rem; color:var(--color-ink); font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-tile strong { font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.25rem; } .ds-tile p { margin:0.4rem 0 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Tile Mint field with 2px ink border.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:3rem; padding:0.55rem 0.9rem; background:var(--color-tile); color:var(--color-ink); border:2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:4px; font:inherit; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Solid status colour with white label; Pending, Completed or Needs Review.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; padding:0.1rem 0.6rem; border-radius:4px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:0.85rem; color:#fff; background:var(--color-review); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; gap:0.5rem; } .ds-seg button { min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.25rem; border:2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-tile); color:var(--color-ink); font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg .ds-on { background:var(--color-teal); color:var(--color-ground); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The whole product is drawn the way its icon sheet is drawn: flat mint paper, objects outlined in navy ink at 2px, small square corners, status carried by a colour square. Nothing floats, glows or leans. A patient or family member reading a plan in a hospital corridor should find the page calm, legible and plain about what is done, what is pending and what a doctor must review.

The landing page (Persuade) and the signed-in screens (Operate) share one vocabulary. Landing alternates bands of mint ground, deeper mint and committed teal; app screens stay on the mint ground with tiles. Real content leads. Six scripts are first-class, so type and line height flex for Indic text.
keyCharacteristics: Flat everywhere: no shadows, no gradients, depth from outline weight and tonal bands.
One ink (navy) for text and every outline; teal is the action and committed-band colour.
4px corners on every tile, button, field and status chip.
Status is a solid colour square plus a word, never colour alone.
The 58 sliced icons from the user's sheet are the only icons.
Motion is one calm entrance rise; no hover animation.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: The lightest surface is Tile Mint (#f4fdf9). Pure white appears only as text on a status chip.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and outlines are Navy Ink. No black, no grey outlines on primary surfaces.

rules.name: The Status Trio Rule
rules.body: Blue, green and orange mean Pending, Completed, Needs Review and nothing else. Do not reuse them as decoration.

rules.name: The Script-Aware Rule
rules.body: Every text role must survive Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam: no negative tracking, no tight line height, no fixed-height text boxes.

rules.name: The Flat Sticker Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to stand out, thicken or darken its outline (2px ink, 3 to 4px teal when selected); never add a shadow.

dos: Do outline every raised object in 2px Navy Ink with 4px corners.
Do pair every status colour with a word or icon.
Do use Tile Mint (#f4fdf9) as the lightest surface and Mint Paper (#eafbf6) as the page.
Do keep touch targets at 48px or more and body text at 18px.
Do use only icons from the sliced sheet in frontend/src/assets/icons.
Do show real content (synthetic sheet, real generated plan, real translations).
Do use skeleton bars for loading, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use gradients, shadows, glows, orbs or dot grids.
Don't add hover animation or animated arrows; state changes are tone steps.
Don't use emoji, em dashes or lucide icons.
Don't use kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't build bento grids or rows of feature cards.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a surface, soft or large corner radii, or rainbow or pastel accents.
Don't use Pending, Completed or Needs Review colours as decoration.
